lines.text: November twelfth. A real day. <short pause> Real clouds over the eastern United States.
This is Cloud Dive, a game for students and aviation fans. You fly. <short pause> Fuel cost is your score.
Icing matters to flights, and avoiding it costs money. A longer path, a climb, or anti-ice fuel.
Today: New York to Nashville.
Cruise runs fast. When Possible or Observed evidence is ahead, the game stops. That is a gate.
First gate. Here only the forecast rule is met, so the label says: possible, forecast only.
Each choice shows the evidence ahead. The costs stay hidden.
I climb to twelve thousand feet, switch anti-ice on, and continue.
At the fifth gate. This cloud comes from satellite data: its top, its phase, an estimated base.
lines.picture: game ramp, then the Blender shots A and B (storyboard section 9); the pause holds the picture

lines.text: The label reads: observed supercooled layer at planned altitude. <short pause> The satellite sees the top. The base is estimated.
I could go around, but a detour costs too. I stay in lane, anti-ice on.
Anti-ice off, flying on? The game’s ice index builds, drag grows, and the dollars climb.
The report compares my cost with three game references.
The costs are itemized: cruise, climb, detour, anti-ice, ice drag.
I finished 38 dollars above Best, the game reference. The report replays Best, gate by gate.
lines.source: T2 take 2026-11-17: report total 3,312 dollars, 38 above Best (3,274); recheck on the frozen build

lines.text: It reads GOES cloud data and an ECMWF forecast, estimates the cloud base with a published method, and corrects for parallax.
No language model. No randomness. No network call in the decision.
In real operations, dispatchers and crews decide, with official icing forecasts and pilot reports. This engine, not yet evaluated, could add where the evidence lies along the route.
In Kiro, a spec defined the requirements and correctness properties.
Writing those properties exposed gaps in our own rules.
Steering holds the wording rules, and a hook runs the wording test on each game-file save.
The limits. The ground is flat. The ice index is a game state, not an icing model. Costs are illustrative. Frame rate measured on one desktop PC.
Cloud Dive. Real data, honestly labeled. <short pause> Play it free, in your browser.
